name: Chore Chart
description: Who does what around the house, and how it's going. Collaborators add recurring chores, give each one to a person and a rhythm (daily, weekly, monthly, or just once), and punch them off as they get done; every person gets their own colour, and each card shows the run so far and the best streak. A chore comes back by itself when its next turn arrives, so the chart is always about this turn rather than a list that grows forever. Viewers and anyone the chart is published to see the same board live and read-only. Chores are the space's chores table (chores.table.jsonl), synced with the space, so any frame there that speaks the chores contract works on the same rows.
